source.title: Settings
source.description: Full reference - every setting under `[tool.uv]` and `[tool.uv.*]` sub-tables in `pyproject.toml`/`uv.toml`, with defaults and TOML examples. Grep by setting name (≈12k words)

source.title: CLI Reference
source.description: Full reference - every command, subcommand, argument and option with defaults and `UV_*` equivalents. Grep by command, never read whole (≈106k words)

source.title: Environment variables
source.description: Full reference - every variable uv reads, including those without a CLI flag: index credentials, proxies, TLS certificates. Grep by name (≈5k words)

source.title: Features
source.description: One-line summary of each main uv command by area, and which `uv pip`/`uv venv` commands replace `pip`, `pip-tools`, `virtualenv`, `pipdeptree`.

source.title: Working on projects
source.description: Beginner walkthrough from `uv init` to `uv build`: what each generated file is for, migrating `requirements.txt`, upgrading packages, and `uv run` versus activating `.venv`.

source.title: Managing dependencies
source.description: `uv add`/`remove` for dependencies, dev groups and extras; Git, URL, path, index or workspace sources, including editable and per-platform.

source.title: Running commands in projects
source.description: Why plain `python` can't import your project; `uv run` with `--with` overriding project pins, Windows `.cmd`/`.bat`/`.ps1` scripts, and Ctrl-C forwarding.

source.title: Configuration files
source.description: Which config file wins and why a setting is ignored (`uv.toml`, workspaces, `uv tool`, `[tool.uv.pip]`); user/system merge order; `.env` loading.

source.title: Python versions
source.description: Why uv picks the interpreter it does: request formats, `.python-version`, discovery order, managed-vs-system preference; plus disabling downloads, free-threaded/debug variants, upgrades.

source.title: Building and publishing a package
source.description: From `uv build --no-sources` to `uv publish`: `uv version` bumps, tokens or trusted publishing, TestPyPI/custom indexes, retrying partial uploads, attestations.

source.title: Using uv with pre-commit
source.description: Official `.pre-commit-config.yaml` hooks that keep `uv.lock` current, export `requirements.txt` from the lockfile, and compile one or more `requirements.in` files.

source.title: Using uv with Jupyter
source.description: Project, standalone or plain-venv setups; `ipykernel` kernels, VS Code, and which environment `!uv add`, `!uv pip install` or `%pip` targets.

source.title: Installing and managing Python
source.description: Quick commands to install (including PyPy), list, reinstall and upgrade Python, and why only versioned `python3.x` lands on `PATH` without `--default`.

source.title: Project structure and files
source.description: Committing `uv.lock` but not `.venv`, avoiding `uv pip install` in the project env, `managed = false`, and `uv.lock` versus `pylock.toml`.

source.title: Creating projects
source.description: Choose a `uv init` layout: default app, `--lib`, `--no-package`, `--bare`, or `--build-backend` for Rust/C extension modules, with the files each creates.

source.title: Locking and syncing
source.description: When `uv.lock` counts as stale, skipping auto-lock/sync (`--locked`/`--frozen`/`--no-sync`), why `uv sync` removes extraneous packages; plus extras, groups, upgrades, Docker layers, `uv export`.

source.title: Configuring projects
source.description: Entry points, whether to package, custom `.venv` path, `VIRTUAL_ENV` mismatch warning, flash-attn/torch build isolation failures, conflicting extras/groups, lockfile platform limits.

source.title: Building distributions
source.description: `uv build` producing sdists and wheels, pinning build dependencies with hashes, and blocking accidental PyPI uploads of private packages.

source.title: The uv build backend
source.description: Configure `uv_build` (pure Python only): modules outside the default `src/` layout, namespace and stub packages, and sdist/wheel file includes and excludes.

source.title: Using uv with marimo
source.description: Standalone `uvx`, `--sandbox` inline-metadata, project or plain-venv setups; where UI-installed packages go, and running notebooks as scripts.

source.title: Using uv in GitHub Actions
source.description: `setup-uv` workflows: version pinning, Python matrices, caching (incl. self-hosted runners), `uv pip --system`, private Git repos, tag-triggered trusted publishing.

source.title: Installing uv
source.description: Every install method, including pinned versions; `uv self update`, shell completion for `uv`/`uvx`, and uninstalling, including leftover pre-0.5 binaries in `~/.cargo/bin`.

source.title: Running scripts
source.description: Standalone `.py` scripts: `--with` versus PEP 723 inline dependencies (`uv add --script`), skipping the surrounding project, script lockfiles, `exclude-newer`, shebangs.

source.title: Tools
source.description: Why `uvx` reuses a cached or installed version; upgrades keeping install constraints, ignored `.python-version`, pipx executable conflicts, versus `uv run`.

source.title: Using tools
source.description: Start here: `uvx` versus installing on `PATH`; `--from` for mismatched package names, versions, extras, git sources; legacy Windows scripts.

source.title: Caching
source.description: Why edited local packages aren't rebuilt (`cache-keys`, `--refresh`, `--reinstall`); clearing, pruning, CI caching, concurrent use, and setting the cache directory.

source.title: Storage
source.description: Where uv stores cache, managed Pythons, tools, executables, config and venvs per OS, and how to show or relocate them.

source.title: Using uv with Dependabot
source.description: Enable `uv.lock` updates with the `uv` `package-ecosystem` in `dependabot.yml`, and match `cooldown` to uv's `exclude-newer` so locking succeeds.
